learner text: 他又爬上去梯子的时候，马先生跟他的驴走去筐的后边来。
quote: 马先生跟他的驴走去筐的后边来
part p0: fix [ref p0/k0] 马先生牵着驴走到筐的后边来 ; notes: “跟/和+noun.” is used for multiple nouns that have the same action, we can say: 马先生和张先生走……，because both 马先生and 张先生 “walk”, but here “驴” does not walk by itself, but walked by 马先生, so you need to use the accompanying phrase “V.着”
part p1: comment [ref p1/note] 走到place来/去，cannot say “走去/来Place”
